8 regularly scheduled maintenance services including
an oil and filter change, tire rotation and multi-point
inspection at each visit at no additional charge. See
dealer for complete details.

that covers repair, replacement or adjustment of parts
at no additional cost, as well as a 6-year/70,000-mile
Powertrain Warranty which features no deductible and is
fully transferable. See dealer for limited warranty details.
